DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗る列車が分からずお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble figuring out which train to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 目的の駅が快速の停車駅に載っていません。各駅停車なら行けるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 快速停車駅にない目的駅へ各駅停車で行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My destination station isn't listed among the rapid service's stops. Can I get there on a train that stops at every station?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a local train can take you to your destination, which isn't among the rapid service's stops. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 駅名を教えていただけますか。似た名前の駅もあるので確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me the station's name? There are stations with similar names, so I'll check.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手帳に書いたこの駅です。名前の最後に「町」が付きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 末尾に町が付く目的駅を手帳で特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's this station written in my notebook. Its name ends with the character 町.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify your destination in your notebook, noting that its name ends in 町. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの駅ですね。この時刻表では、各駅停車の欄に停車の印があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This station, then. On this timetable, there's a stop symbol in the local train column.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今ホームにいる列車は、その各駅停車ですか。表示に行き先しか出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ホームの列車が目的の各駅停車か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is the train at the platform now that local train? The display only shows its destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the train at the platform is the local train you need. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その列車は快速です。次の列車の種別表示を確かめてからお乗りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That train is a rapid service. Please check the next train's service type display before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 快速には乗らずに待ちます。次の列車の表示で「普通」を探せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 快速を見送り普通の種別表示を探す方法を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait instead of boarding the rapid train. Should I look for 普通, meaning local, on the next train's display?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you should let the rapid train go and look for the local service type display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、ただし行き先も確認してください。目的駅まで行かない列車もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, but check its destination too. Some trains don't go as far as your station.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「普通」と行き先の両方を見ます。判断できなければ、乗る前にもう一度伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 種別と行き先を確認し不明なら乗車前に再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check both 普通 and the destination. If I can't tell, I'll ask again before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the service type and destination and ask again before boarding if unsure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 迷ったら近くの係員に声をかけてください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: If you're unsure, please speak to a nearby staff member. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振り込みの操作についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking how to make a bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を振り込みたいのですが、大家さんから依頼人名に部屋番号を加えるよう言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃の依頼人名に部屋番号を追加したい事情を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to transfer my rent, but my landlord told me to add my room number to the sender's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you want to add your room number to the sender's name for a rent transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入力方法は利用する画面によります。今日はどの方法で振り込みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: How you enter it depends on the screen you're using. How will you make the transfer today?

DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 銀行の機械を使う予定です。口座名義そのものを変える必要はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 機械で振り込む予定を伝えて口座名義変更が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm planning to use the bank's machine. Do I need to change the actual name on my account?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you'll transfer using a machine and ask whether the account holder's name needs changing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 口座名義の変更と振込依頼人名の入力は別の手続きです。機械の画面を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Changing the account holder's name and entering the transfer sender's name are separate procedures. Let's check the machine's screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入力欄があれば、部屋番号を名前の前に付けたいです。文字数の上限も画面に出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋番号を名前の前に付ける希望と文字数表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: If there's an input field, I'd like to put the room number before my name. Will the screen also show the character limit?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that you want the room number before your name and check whether the character limit is displayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示を一緒に確認できます。入りきらないときは勝手に略さず、大家さんへ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check the display together. If it won't all fit, don't abbreviate it on your own; consult your landlord.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前が途中で切れたら振り込まず、大家さんにどこを短くするか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前が切れた場合は振込を止め大家に略し方を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If my name gets cut off, I won't make the transfer. I'll ask my landlord which part to shorten.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll stop the transfer if your name is cut off and ask your landlord how to abbreviate it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうしましょう。確認画面では依頼人名だけでなく、振込先と金額も見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's do that. On the confirmation screen, review the recipient and amount as well as the sender's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 振込先と金額も照合します。表示名が決まるまでは最後の確定ボタンを押しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 振込先金額を照合して表示名確定前に送信しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the recipient and amount too. I won't press the final confirmation button until the displayed name is settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the recipient and amount and won't submit before settling the displayed name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分からない表示があれば、確定前にお呼びください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: If there's anything on the display you don't understand, call me before confirming. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬をお渡しする前に、お名前を一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before I give you your medicine, let's check your name together.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この袋の名前は一文字違います。私の名前はこちらの診察券に書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薬袋の氏名の一文字違いを診察券で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The name on this bag differs by one character. My name is written on this patient card.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Use your patient card to show the one-character difference in the name on the medicine bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 教えてくださってありがとうございます。処方箋と記録を確認するので、まだ袋を開けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for telling me. I'll check the prescription and records, so please don't open the bag yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。袋の表記だけの間違いか、別の人の薬なのか確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表記誤りか別人の薬か処方との照合を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. Could you check whether only the name on the bag is wrong or whether it's someone else's medicine?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a prescription check to determine whether it's a name error or someone else's medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、処方内容とお薬を照合します。確認中の袋はこちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, I'll compare the medicine with the prescription. We'll hold on to the bag while we check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋をお返しします。同じ名前の人と取り違えていないかも気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋を返し同名の人との取り違えの懸念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll give you the bag back. I'm also concerned it might have been mixed up with someone with the same name.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Return the bag and express concern about a mix-up with someone with the same name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も含めて確認します。結果が分かるまではお渡しできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check that as well. We can't hand it over until we know the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は時間に余裕があるので待ちます。受付の呼び出し名も正しい表記にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待つ時間があると伝え受付の呼び出し名訂正を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have plenty of time today, so I'll wait. Please also correct the name used to call me at reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have time to wait and ask to correct the name reception calls out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付の登録も見直します。お待ちになる間、こちらの席をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll review the reception registration too. Please use this seat while you wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この席で待っています。確認が終わったら、正しい名前と薬の内容をもう一度一緒に見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 席で待ち確認後に氏名と薬の内容の再確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait in this seat. Once you've finished checking, I'd like us to review the correct name and the medicine details together again.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait in the seat and want to recheck the name and medicine details afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認後に改めてご説明しますね。それまでお掛けになってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll explain everything again after checking. Until then, please take a seat and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 戻ってきた郵便物のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about mail that was returned to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私が出した手紙が戻りました。宛先不明とありますが、切手を足せば届くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛先不明で返送された手紙に切手追加が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: A letter I sent came back. It says the address was unknown. Will it get there if I add stamps?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether more stamps are needed for a letter returned because the address was unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 料金ではなく宛先の確認が必要です。住所の建物名や部屋番号に抜けはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The address needs checking, rather than the postage. Did you leave out the building name or room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相手は集合住宅に住んでいますが、部屋番号を書き忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 集合住宅の部屋番号を書き忘れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The recipient lives in an apartment building, but I forgot to write the room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you forgot the room number of the apartment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず相手に正しい住所全体を確認してください。新しい封筒で再送する場合の料金もご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, check the full correct address with the recipient. We can also explain the postage if you resend it in a new envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手に聞いてから書き直します。戻った封筒の切手を新しい封筒に移して使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所確認後に書き直すと伝えて元の切手の再利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll rewrite it after asking the recipient. Can I move the stamp from the returned envelope to the new one and use it?
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll rewrite the address after checking and ask whether you can reuse the original stamp. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使用済みの切手は再利用できません。再送の料金は、封筒の重さなどを見て確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Used stamps can't be reused. Let's check the postage for resending it based on the envelope's weight and other factors.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この手紙と封筒だけを送る予定です。重さを量って、必要な切手を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送る手紙と封筒を示し重さに応じた切手を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm planning to send only this letter and envelope. Please weigh them and tell me what stamps I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the letter and envelope you're sending and ask for stamps appropriate to their weight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 量った重さに応じた料金を案内します。住所は部屋番号まで確認してから投函してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell you the postage based on the measured weight. Before posting it, please check the address right down to the room number.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 料金分の切手を買います。今日は投函せず、相手の返事を待って住所を完成させます。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切手を購入し投函を保留して相手の住所回答を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll buy stamps for that amount. I won't post it today; I'll wait for the recipient's reply and complete the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll buy stamps, hold off on posting, and wait for the recipient's address reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 住所が整ってからお出しくださいね。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-032-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please send it once you have the complete address. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札の前でお困りですか。お持ちのきっぷを確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble here in front of the ticket gates? May I check your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新幹線の看板を追って来ましたが、これから乗るのは在来線かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 在来線のきっぷなのに新幹線の看板を追った可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I followed the Shinkansen signs, but the train I'm taking may actually be a conventional line train.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you may have followed Shinkansen signs despite having a conventional line ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このきっぷは在来線ですね。こちらではなく、在来線の改札へ向かってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This ticket is for a conventional line. Please head for the conventional line gates, rather than these.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: スーツケースが重いので、階段を通らない行き方を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 重いスーツケースを理由に階段を避ける経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My suitcase is heavy. Could you tell me a route that doesn't involve stairs?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a route avoiding stairs because your suitcase is heavy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内図では、エレベーターを使う経路が青い線で示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this map, the route using elevators is shown by a blue line.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い線が途中で曲がっていますが、今いる場所は図のどこでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青い経路と現在地の関係を案内図で聞き直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The blue line turns partway along. Where are we now on the map?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the map to ask again how the blue route relates to your current location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 赤い印が現在地です。曲がった先で、在来線と書かれた案内を探してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The red mark is your current location. After the turn, look for signs saying conventional lines.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ乗るまで時間がありますが、エレベーターが使えなかったらここへ戻ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: エレベーターが使えないときの相談先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I still have time before my train. If the elevator isn't available, should I come back here?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whom to ask if the elevator can't be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、改札の係員にも相談できます。無理に荷物を持って階段へ進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, and you can also ask the staff at the ticket gates. Don't force yourself to carry your luggage up or down the stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず青い線に沿って移動し、在来線の改札でホームをもう一度確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 在来線改札でホームを再確認する移動順を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll follow the blue line first, then check my platform again at the conventional line gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe your sequence of travel, including checking the platform again at the conventional line gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順番で大丈夫ですので、荷物の車輪に気をつけてお進みください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: That order is fine. Please watch your luggage wheels as you go. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの案内図をお使いになりますか。見学のお時間はどのくらいありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to use this map? How much time do you have to look around?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 四十分後に入口で友人と会うので、遠くまで行かずに庭を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四十分後の入口での待ち合わせに合わせて見学希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm meeting a friend at the entrance in forty minutes, so I'd like to see the garden without going far.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your sightseeing wishes in light of meeting a friend at the entrance in forty minutes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、戻る時間を含めて考えましょう。広い範囲を見るより、近くの景色を選びませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then let's allow time for getting back too. How about choosing nearby scenery rather than covering a large area?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池のそばを見たいのですが、入口からの道を図で指していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池へ向かう道を案内図で示してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to see the area by the pond. Could you point out the path from the entrance on the map?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to have the route to the pond pointed out on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 池の表示はこちらです。通れる道は、現地の掲示も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The pond is marked here. Please also check the signs on site to see which paths are open.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ道を戻るつもりですが、分かれ道で覚えておくとよい目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 分かれ道で入口を見失わない目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I plan to return along the same path. Is there a useful landmark to remember at the fork?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a landmark at the fork to avoid losing your way back to the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内板の位置を目印にできます。曲がる前に入口の方向を確かめておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use the location of this signboard as a landmark. Check the direction of the entrance before turning.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし道が混んでいたら、池まで行かずに近くの見学だけに変えてもよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 混雑時に池まで行かず見学範囲を縮める案を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the path is crowded, I could change my plan to look around nearby without going as far as the pond, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check your plan to shorten the visit and skip the pond if it's crowded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうですね。待ち合わせを優先して、余裕を残してお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Give priority to meeting your friend and come back with time to spare.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二十分ほどで折り返すことにして、この案内板の位置をメモしてから出発します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二十分で折り返し案内板を記録する計画を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll turn back after about twenty minutes and make a note of this signboard's location before setting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe your plan to turn back in twenty minutes and record the signboard's location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内図はお持ちください。どうぞ、短い時間でも庭の景色をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the map with you. Enjoy the garden scenery, even in the short time you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その展示の前には、撮影についての表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: There's a sign about photography in front of that exhibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口では写真を撮りましたが、この展示室でも同じように撮ってよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入口と展示室で撮影条件が同じだと思っていたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took photos at the entrance and thought I could take them the same way in this exhibition room.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought photography conditions were the same at the entrance and in the exhibition room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所ごとに条件が違いますので、この禁止表示がある展示は撮らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The conditions differ by location, so please don't photograph exhibits with this prohibition sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 撮らずに展示名をメモしたいのですが、ここに立ったままだと通路を塞ぎますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示名のメモで通路を塞がない位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to write down the exhibit's name instead of photographing it. Would I block the walkway if I stayed here?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask where to write down the exhibit's name without blocking the walkway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 後ろの方が通れなくなりそうですので、少し脇へ寄ってメモをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: It looks as though people behind you wouldn't be able to get past, so please move a little to the side to take notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 脇のベンチでメモをまとめてから、撮影できる場所の案内を聞いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベンチで記録をまとめてから撮影範囲を聞く許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I put my notes together on the bench to the side, then ask about the places where photography is allowed?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask permission to organize your notes on the bench and then ask about areas where photos are allowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: もちろんです。撮れる範囲は、その場所の表示を見ながらご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. I'll explain where you can take photos while we look at the signs in each place.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人と一緒に写りたいときも、背景に禁止の展示が入らないようにするのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の写真にも禁止展示を写さない理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even when I want a photo with my friend, I need to keep prohibited exhibits out of the background, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm your understanding that prohibited exhibits must not appear even in photos of your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、禁止の展示が写る位置では撮らず、ほかの見学者の通行にもご配慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Don't take photos from a position that includes prohibited exhibits, and please consider other visitors passing by too.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この展示は文字だけで記録して、写真は表示を確かめた別の場所で撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 展示は文字で記録し写真は許可表示のある場所にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll record this exhibit only in writing and take photos elsewhere after checking the signs.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll record the exhibit in writing and take photos somewhere with a sign permitting them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご理解ありがとうございます。続きをごゆっくりご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for understanding. Please take your time enjoying the rest of the exhibits.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の「症状の経過」の欄が空いていますね。記入でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: The symptom progression section of your medical questionnaire is blank. Are you having trouble filling it in?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右ひざが三日前から痛みますが、昨日から階段を下りるときに強く痛むことを、どう書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右ひざの痛みが始まった時期と昨日からの変化の書き方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My right knee has hurt for three days, but since yesterday it hurts badly when I go downstairs. How should I write that?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to write when the right knee pain began and how it changed since yesterday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今お話しになった順番で、始まった時期と変わったことを書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please write when it started and what changed, in the order you just described.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「三日前から右ひざが痛み、昨日から階段を下りるときに悪化した」と書いてみました。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 階段を下りる際に悪化した経過を一文で記入して示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've written, 'My right knee has hurt for three days, and since yesterday it has become worse when going downstairs.'
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your one-sentence description of the pain worsening when going downstairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 経過が伝わる書き方ですね。ほかに医師へ伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: That clearly explains the progression. Is there anything else you'd like to tell the doctor?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 座っているときの痛みは少ないので、その点も同じ欄に足しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 座っているときは痛みが少ないことを追記する意向を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It hurts less when I'm sitting, so I'd like to add that in the same section.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'd like to add that the pain is less when sitting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き足してください。症状についての判断は、診察で医師が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please add it. The doctor will assess your symptoms during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 診察では説明を聞き取れないことがあるので、大事な点をゆっくり話してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察の重要な説明をゆっくり話してほしいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I sometimes can't follow explanations during consultations, so I'd like the important points explained slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the important explanations during the consultation to be spoken slowly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望を伝えておきます。わからなかったところは、その場で聞き返して構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on your request. You can ask again on the spot about anything you didn't understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記入した経過を見ながら説明し、聞き取れない言葉は診察中に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問診票を見て経過を説明し不明な言葉を聞き返す方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the progression while looking at what I've written, and ask about words I can't catch during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll use the questionnaire to explain the progression and ask again about unfamiliar words. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 問診票を受付へお出しください。では、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please hand the questionnaire in at reception. Take care, and I hope you feel better.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お届け物でしょうか。袋に入っている物について伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you handing something in? I'll ask about what's in the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩道で鍵を拾いましたので、持ち主が探しているかもしれないと思って持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩道で拾った鍵を持ち主のために届けたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a key on the sidewalk and brought it in because I thought its owner might be looking for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought in a key found on the sidewalk for its owner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。見つけた時刻と場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Please tell me when and where you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝八時ごろ、パン屋の前の交差点で、信号を渡る手前に落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝八時ごろ信号を渡る手前で見つけた状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around eight this morning, it was lying at the intersection in front of the bakery, just before crossing at the traffic lights.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you found it around eight in the morning, before crossing at the traffic lights. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どちら側の歩道か確認したいので、この周辺図をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'd like to check which side of the street the sidewalk was on. Please look at this local map.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 店はこの角にあり、私が鍵を拾ったのは店と同じ側の歩道です。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 周辺図でパン屋と同じ側の歩道を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The shop is on this corner, and I picked up the key on the sidewalk on the same side as the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the local map to identify the sidewalk on the same side as the bakery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所を記録します。拾ったあと、鍵や袋に変わったことはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record the location. Has anything about the key or bag changed since you picked it up?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鍵には触りましたが、付いていた札は外していませんし、袋は家から持ってきたものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵への接触と札を外していない状態と袋の出所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I touched the key, but I haven't removed the tag attached to it. The bag is one I brought from home.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you touched the key, left its tag attached, and brought the bag from home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。届け出に必要な事項を説明しますので、連絡先の記入をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I'll explain the information needed for the report, so please fill in your contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先を書きますので、受け取る控えには届けた物の内容も載るか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を記入し届け出控えの物品記載を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write my contact details. Could you tell me whether the receipt I receive will also list the item I handed in?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Fill in your contact details and ask whether the report receipt will describe the item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 控えには届けていただいた物の内容も記録しますので、ご確認ください。お届けいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: The receipt will also record the details of the item you handed in, so please check them. Thank you for bringing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 水筒のふたをご覧になっていますね。どのような物をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the drinking bottle lids. What kind are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場へお茶を持っていきたいのですが、今の水筒はふたの細かい部分を洗うのが大変です。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場用水筒のふたの細部を洗う負担を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to take tea to work, but it's difficult to wash the small parts of my current bottle's lid.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difficulty of washing the fine parts of the lid of your bottle for work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらはふたの部品が少ないタイプです。外せる部分を説明しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This type has fewer lid parts. Would you like me to explain which parts come off?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 毎晩洗うので、パッキンを道具なしで外せるか見せていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 毎日の手入れのため道具なしでパッキンを外せるか実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wash it every night, so I'd like you to show me whether the gasket can be removed without tools.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a demonstration of removing the gasket without tools for daily cleaning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 展示品で確かめましょう。ここを外したあと、取り付ける向きにも注意が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check using the display model. After removing this, you also need to pay attention to which way it goes back in.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 向きが反対だと困るので、説明書に取り付け方の図が載っているかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明書のパッキン取り付け方向の図を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Putting it in the wrong way would be a problem, so I'd also like to know whether the manual has a diagram showing how to fit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the manual has a diagram showing which way to fit the gasket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: このページに図があります。お使いになる前に、ふたが正しく閉まるか確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's a diagram on this page. Before using it, check that the lid closes correctly.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その図ならわかりそうですので、予備のパッキンを含めた金額を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予備パッキンを含めた購入金額を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I think I can understand that diagram, so please tell me the price including a spare gasket.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the purchase price including a spare gasket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予備の部品は別売りか確認して、買える場合の合計額をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check whether spare parts are sold separately and tell you the total if they can be bought.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部品の値段を聞いてから決めたいので、今日はまだレジへ持っていかずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部品価格の確認が済むまで購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to decide after hearing the part's price, so I won't take it to the checkout yet today; I'll wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off on buying until the part's price has been checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認してこちらでお知らせします。ほかの商品も、どうぞご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check and let you know here. Please feel free to look at our other products too.
